sentences.text: Ashim Barman vs Unknown on 18 May, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

18.05.2023 Sl.32 C.R.M. (A) 2069 of 2023 Court No.29 (AD) In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of (Allowed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Patiram Police Station Case No. 03 of 2023 dated 03.01.2023 under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
And In the matter of: Ashim Barman ....petitioner.

Mr. Sayan De Mr. Sayan Kanjilal Mr. Koustav Shome ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, Ld. PP Ms. Faria Hossain Ms. Mamata Jana ...for the State.
Petitioner before us stands on the same footing as that of the two other co-accuseds who were enlarged on anticipatory bail by the order dated April 26, 2023 passed in CRM (A) 1766 of 2023.
Consequently, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a Bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only), with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default, the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
The prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
